title: Add CSV export for weekly reports
summary: Allows users to download their weekly activity reports in standard CSV spreadsheet format.

title: Resolve session timeout logout issue
summary: Fixes a bug where active users were prematurely logged out after 15 minutes of activity.

title: Remove deprecated v1 OAuth endpoints
summary: Removes legacy v1 authentication endpoints in favor of modern OAuth 2.0 PKCE flow. Applications must migrate to v2.

title: Correct date format in localized emails
summary: Ensures notification email timestamps adhere to user locale instead of defaulting to UTC.

title: Add dark mode toggle in user preferences
summary: Introduces a sleek high-contrast dark theme selectable directly in the user settings dashboard.
